mechanism: Nafcillin may reduce torsemide efficacy through enzyme induction and increased renal clearance, while torsemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia may increase nafcillin-associated nephrotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly, assess renal function periodically, and consider alternative antibiotics or adjust loop diuretic dosing if significant electrolyte depletion occurs.
